draft_reply.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the note. I have listed what I found below, and I have not accepted any of it as a commitment.

Requests mentioned:
- Complete the landing page. Owner: Alex. Deadline: November 10.
- Send the final product screenshots to the marketing team. Owner: Alex. Deadline: November 7.
- Confirm whether the pricing page is ready. Owner: Alex. Deadline: not specified.
- Review the campaign copy. Owner: John. Deadline: November 8.
- Schedule a final review meeting. Owner: Unassigned. Deadline: once these items are complete.

These points are ambiguous, so this draft asks rather than guessing:
- The deadline "November 10" has no year in the email, so no calendar date is assigned. Which year applies?
- The deadline "November 7" has no year in the email, so no calendar date is assigned. Which year applies?
- The deadline "November 8" has no year in the email, so no calendar date is assigned. Which year applies?
- Who should own "Schedule a final review meeting."?

Questions that still need a response:
- Is the pricing page ready?

This draft can be edited before anything is sent. It does not confirm dates, owners, or next steps on your behalf. It remains a draft until you approve it.

Best,
Alex
